vte...@wizards.com (LSJ) wrote:
> davey sprocket <dhat...@midway.uchicago.edu> wrote:
> >
> > when your Dauntain or Ethan Locke steals a master discipline
> > card from another methuselah['s vampire], do you gain
> > control of the master discipline card in addition to having
> > it move to a [vampire] you control?
>
> No. Card text doesn't say that control is changed.

Scratch that. "Steal" implies a change of control. So "yes", you
would get control of the discipline card that your Dauntain or
Ethan steals.
